candidates.hypothesis: Mean reversion of M1 price action following an exhaustion candle is more statistically significant when filtered by a low-volatility regime.
candidates.candle_definition: Exhaustion candle: Bullish if (Close - Open) / (High - Low) < 0.2 and (Close - Open) > 0; Bearish if (Open - Close) / (High - Low) < 0.2 and (Open - Close) > 0; Body size > 1.5 * Average(abs(Close - Open), 10).
candidates.entry_logic: Enter long if exhaustion candle is bearish and price breaks above High of exhaustion candle; enter short if exhaustion candle is bullish and price breaks below Low of exhaustion candle.
candidates.exit_logic: Fixed stop loss at 1.5 * ATR(14); take profit at 2.0 * risk.
candidates.context_filters: Low-volatility regime required: ATR(14) < 20-period moving average of ATR(14).
unresolved_questions: Does the M1 noise floor render the exhaustion signal statistically indistinguishable from random walk?

candidates.hypothesis: Momentum continuation following a breakout of a narrow range (NR-N) is more robust when confirmed by volatility expansion.

operator_assumptions.narrow_range_definition: Current candle range (High - Low) is the minimum range across the prior N candles; N is searched only within 5-10 in C.

candidates.candle_definition: NR-N candle: current (High - Low) < min of (High-Low) for each of the prior N candles, where N is bounded to 5-10.
candidates.entry_logic: Enter long if price exceeds High of the identified NR-N candle + breakout_buffer; enter short if price falls below Low of the identified NR-N candle - breakout_buffer.
candidates.exit_logic: Trailing stop based on 2.0 * ATR(14) from current price.
unresolved_questions: Is the NR-N pattern frequency sufficient on M1 to overcome transaction costs?

candidates.hypothesis: Pin-bar reversal patterns at key support/resistance levels exhibit higher success rates when the wick-to-body ratio exceeds a specific threshold.

operator_assumptions.support_resistance_definition: Pivot points calculated from previous day High/Low/Close.

candidates.candle_definition: Pin-bar: ((High - Low) > 3 * abs(Close - Open)) AND (((min(Close, Open) - Low) / (High - Low) > 0.75) OR ((High - max(Close, Open)) / (High - Low) > 0.75)).
candidates.entry_logic: Enter long if pin-bar occurs within 0.05% of S1/S2 pivot; enter short if pin-bar occurs within 0.05% of R1/R2 pivot.
candidates.exit_logic: Stop loss at the extreme of the pin-bar wick; take profit at next pivot level.
unresolved_questions: Does the definition of 'key level' provide enough edge to offset the high frequency of false breakouts on M1?
